blip_pool.note: VALIDATE_SIZE(tRadarTrace, 0x14) = 20B. ms_RadarTrace[1024] is the live blip table; indices 0..1023 are stable for the duration of a slot's lifetime.

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_fX
tRadarTrace_fields.note: world-space X coordinate of the blip (east/west)

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_fY
tRadarTrace_fields.note: world-space Y coordinate of the blip (north/south)

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_nColor
tRadarTrace_fields.note: packed RGBA colour; written by SetBlipColour and used directly in minimap rendering

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_nBlipType
tRadarTrace_fields.note: slot type: 0=free, 1=CAR (vehicle), 2=CHAR (ped), 3=OBJECT, 4=COORDS (fixed position). Determines how the XY is refreshed each frame.

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_nBlipDisplayFlag
tRadarTrace_fields.note: display mode: 0=hidden, 1=show on minimap only, 2=show on both minimap and main map

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_nCounter
tRadarTrace_fields.note: allocation counter; combined with slot index to build the opaque blip handle returned to SCM scripts

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_bFriendly
tRadarTrace_fields.note: true = blip belongs to a friendly entity; affects icon colour

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_nBlipSize
tRadarTrace_fields.note: visual radius on the minimap (0=1px dot, higher = larger); set by SetBlipSize SCM opcode

tRadarTrace_fields.name: m_nAssociatedEntityHandle
tRadarTrace_fields.note: pool index of the associated vehicle/ped/object; -1 when m_nBlipType==COORDS

blip_handle_encoding.description: A blip handle returned to SCM is: (m_nCounter << 16) | slot_index

blip_types.1: RADAR_TRACE_CAR    — attached to a vehicle; XY updated from vehicle position each frame
blip_types.2: RADAR_TRACE_CHAR   — attached to a ped; XY updated from ped position each frame
blip_types.3: RADAR_TRACE_OBJECT — attached to a CObject; XY updated from object position
blip_types.4: RADAR_TRACE_COORDS — fixed world coordinates; not updated each frame

minimap_rendering.radar_rect: drawn as a circle clipped to the disc using the screen transform
minimap_rendering.north_up: minimap is always north-up; blip XY rotated by -(player heading) only for the rotating variant (switchable by player preference)
minimap_rendering.zone_names: CZone text appears on the radar disc when CZone::ms_pTheTargetZone changes
minimap_rendering.map_texture_txd: radar0.txd .. radar63.txd — streamed in as the player moves
